text:
emily: Hey @raj @dan @lauren — can you take quick eyes on https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/66077?
Small routing fallback change (no DB/schema changes). Unit tests pass and I ran a local canary replay. Planning to merge in tomorrow's 09:00 PST merge slot if we get approvals.

Patch is tiny, main change is fallback order in router; no surfaced API changes. Local repro steps:```
git fetch origin pull/66077/head:pr-66077
git checkout pr-66077
./scripts/bench --model=gpt4-small --iters=50 --seq=512
```
Would especially like:
- runtime perf sanity (p50/p95 impact) — @raj
- infra implications for cache/eviction/quota — @dan
- security quick check for auth header ordering/KMS pattern — @lauren

mike: emily can you paste the p50/p95 from your bench run and add a one-paragraph rollout note to the PR description? :pray:

raj: looking now. can you also run bench with `--batch-size=8`? i want to see batching behavior. rough numbers on my machine with a similar trace: p50 +2ms, p95 +12ms vs main. i'll run the batch-size=8 and post results.

lauren: quick read — doesn't touch token storage. i will scan for any sync KMS calls. if nothing hits KMS path, i can sign off today. :thumbsup:

dan: infra note — does this change cache lease or prefetch lifecycle? If eviction pressure could increase we need a fallback reservation plan. Also add a brief rollback plan (how to revert routing flag). pinging @oliver for canary stewarding.

oliver: I can steward the canary tomorrow 09:00 PST. I'll watch cache_miss_rate, eviction_rate, and tail_latency. If any metric spikes >20% we roll back.

emily: thanks all — added bench outputs and rollout notes to the PR description. bench summary (local, --batch-size=1 -> --batch-size=8):
- p50: 18ms -> 20ms
- p95: 74ms -> 86ms
No KMS/token touches. No cache lease changes in this patch. Rollout plan in PR: canary 09:00 PST 10% -> 50% after 30m if stable -> full at 2h. Rollback command included.

deploy-bot: CI checks passed — `ci/circleci` ✅

mike: looks good. @raj @lauren @dan please drop final LGTM when you have it so emily can grab the 09:00 slot.

raj: ran with --batch-size=8 on my workstation: p50 +3ms, p95 +14ms, CPU and GPU utilization steady. LGTM from runtime side once infra is happy. :white_check_mark:

lauren: security OK — verified header ordering and async KMS call pattern unchanged. LGTM.

dan: infra ok, no lease changes and eviction delta negligible in replay. I approve, leaving canary steward to oliver.

emily: great — merging in the 09:00 PST window after @oliver starts the canary. thanks everyone! :rocket:
